title: Selected capture filters events but retains unfiltered values
expected_semantics: Selected capture retains only the observations attributable to the selected operations, so targeted witnesses stay small.
actual_behavior_limitation: Selected capture retains 2 targeted events but all 5 values (identical value set to bounded capture), so witnesses stay large even for single-operation stop sets (77KB vs 120KB on the nested fixture).
why_capability_matters: Targeted debugging without giant process logs needs value capture scoped to the selection; otherwise every stop set drags the full value context.
current_workaround: Stop sets report matched events (the targeted part) and treat retained values as ambient context; witnesses remain bounded but not minimal.

host_language_code_required.why: No host code involved; the runtime decides the value filter.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Scope selected capture values to the selected operations (plus request/response roots), or document values as intentionally ambient with a separate value-selection contract.
alternatives_considered: max-values clamping per stop set (loses targeted values first)
tests_evidence: break record-mode: 16 bounded events vs 4 selected events with identical 5 values
resolution_criteria: A selected-capture observation documents and implements its value filter, and stop-set witnesses carry only selection-attributable values plus declared roots.
